origin.description: Map each string to title case with an ICU break iterator.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

arguments.name: opts_brkiter
arguments.text: Break iterator settings. NULL uses a word iterator and the default locale.
Further break iterator settings, including type and locale.

origin.details: The default word iterator titles each word. type "sentence" titles each sentence. "one. two. three." is one sentence, so only the first word is titled. A missing string stays missing.
origin.example:
x <- stri_trans_totitle("stringi is a FREE R pAcKaGe. WItH NO StrinGS attached.")
cat(paste0("stri_trans_totitle of the stringi sentence returns ", x, ".\n"))

translation.description: Map each string to title case with an ICU break iterator.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

arguments.name: opts_brkiter
arguments.text: Break iterator settings. NULL uses a word iterator and the default locale.
Further break iterator settings, including type and locale.

translation.details: ICU UnicodeString.toTitle uses a word break iterator unless type is sentence, line_break, or character. locale is the break iterator locale. Turkish tr_TR titles iPhone as dotted I plus phone. A missing string stays missing.
translation.value: A string, or NA. A list returns a list. None returns an empty list.
translation.example:
from stringi.trans import stri_trans_totitle
x = stri_trans_totitle("stringi is a FREE R pAcKaGe. WItH NO StrinGS attached.")
print(f"stri_trans_totitle of the stringi sentence returns {x}.")
